# Hacker News

> Community-driven technology news aggregator and discussion platform featuring startup launches, developer tools, and open-source projects.

Hacker News is a social news website focused on computer science and entrepreneurship, operated by Y Combinator. It serves as a platform for tech professionals, developers, and startup founders to share and discuss news, ask questions, and showcase projects.

## Key Topics

- Community Submissions
- Tech News
- Startup Launches
- Open Source
- Developer Tools
- AI/Machine Learning
- Y Combinator
- News Aggregation
- Community Guidelines
- Karma System
- Moderation
- Security
- Job Listings
- Project Showcases
- Q&A Discussion

## Main Feed & Discovery

- [Hacker News Homepage](https://news.ycombinator.com): Hacker News homepage: tech news aggregator with community submissions
- [Main Feed](https://news.ycombinator.com/news): Hacker News main feed: community-driven tech and startup news
- [Newest Submissions](https://news.ycombinator.com/newest): Latest submissions to Hacker News by newest timestamp
- [New Comments](https://news.ycombinator.com/newcomments): Real-time stream of newest comments across Hacker News

## Community Features

- [Ask HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/ask): Ask HN: community Q&A section for questions and discussions
- [Show HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/show): Show HN: community submissions of projects and product launches
- [Job Listings](https://news.ycombinator.com/jobs): Hacker News job listings for Y Combinator companies and startups
- [Lists & Navigation](https://news.ycombinator.com/lists): Navigation page listing curated views and community features
- [Filter by Source](https://news.ycombinator.com/from): Filter submissions by source or user on Hacker News

## Guidelines & Support

- [Community Guidelines](https://news.ycombinator.com/newsguidelines.html): Community guidelines and content policy for Hacker News
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://news.ycombinator.com/newsfaq.html): FAQ covering ranking, karma system, and Hacker News features
- [Security & Vulnerability Reporting](https://news.ycombinator.com/security.html): Security disclosure and vulnerability reporting for Hacker News

## Optional

- [Front Page Archive](https://news.ycombinator.com/front): Hacker News front page archive for specific date
